name: Trigger order owned by a Swig wallet, in simulation
threshold: in mainnet simulation, a Trigger V2 order is created with the Swig wallet (a program-derived address) as owner, a cancel returns funds, and the vault deposit reduces the Swig allowance by exactly the deposit
notes: Copied from T-F06a's Acceptance line before anything ran. Exactly is the strict word in the last clause: a deposit reducing the allowance by more would let a rule eat an agent's budget, by less would let an agent spend past its cap through the vault, so the bar is equality and not a tolerance. The clause that needs no chain is checked first, because a refusal there makes the rest unreachable.
